planets.name: WASP-48 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of WASP-48 with a 2.14-day year, found in 2011.

text.card: WASP-48 b was found in 2011 by SuperWASP as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around WASP-48. Its orbit and size follow Stassun et al. 2017's fit, the archive's default.
text.locator: NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table, default parameter set (pl_refname STASSUN_ET_AL__2017): disc_year 2011, disc_facility SuperWASP, sy_pnum 1; pl_orbper 2.14363679, pl_radj 1.5, pl_bmassj 0.8

thermal.source: Deming et al. 2023, dayside brightness temperature at 3.6 µm (uniform reanalysis of Spitzer's eclipses, CDS J/AJ/165/104 table 2)
thermal.chosen: 2 measured of 2 rows; the smallest relative uncertainty, then the longest wavelength
